subject: Grabbing a single grob from a plot

messages.author: b5dedeb3b5ed5e46
messages.subject: Grabbing a single grob from a plot
parts:
Hi,

I am struggling with the idea of grabbing a single grob from the
complex gTree produced by ggplot.
I would like to grab just the panel gTree. I have not been able to
figure out how to specify gPath in
getGrob(grob,gPath(??)) command.

Thanks,

~Russ

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Grabbing a single grob from a plot
parts:
Hi Russ,

Start by rendering the plot on screen and then using grid.ls(). The
grobs should have sufficiently unique names that you can use getGrob
with global = TRUE to find the one that you're looking for.

Hadley
